required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: The instantaneous scalar normal-contact state is a many-to-one map from finite-area geometry and pressure configurations, so states with different future wrench and constraint consequences are aliased before impedance actions are ranked.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Replace the raw scalar snapshot with the coarsest observable spatial quotient that separates contact configurations only when their conditional future wrench, constraint margin, or impedance-action consequences differ.
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: A decision-sufficient spatial quotient directly removes the action-relevant part of finite-area aliasing without presuming that full fields, a particular sensor, or a particular contact model are necessary.
acceptance_conditions: Conditioned on the simple state, the retained statistic predicts held-out future wrench or constraint consequences beyond calibration uncertainty.

Removing it changes rendered impedance beyond implementation resolution and improves at least one prespecified held-out endpoint beyond its equivalence margin under matched resources, or it is rejected as unnecessary.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: A normal-only state does not encode where the distributed contact wrench lies relative to direction-dependent slip and moment-capacity boundaries.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Transform available contact information into the minimum observable coordinate of remaining tangential and moment authority that can change a safe impedance ranking before a limit event.
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: A capacity-relative coordinate targets the causal intermediate state—misestimated slip or moment margin—without committing to six-axis wrench input, a Coulomb cone, or any specific optimizer.
acceptance_conditions: The coordinate anticipates independently measured slip, contact loss, or moment-limit approach after conditioning on normal force, pose, speed, and randomized friction conditions.
Its inclusion changes impedance before—not only after—a limit event and improves a held-out safety or task endpoint without material loss elsewhere, or it is rejected as redundant.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: Instantaneous indentation, rate, and wrench are non-Markov when distinct load histories yield different future force, area, recovery, or capacity, while unconstrained detailed constitutive state can be nonidentifiable.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Replace unbounded raw history or memoryless snapshots with the lowest-dimensional stable predictive state that makes future action-relevant contact consequences conditionally history-independent over the decision horizon.
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: Predictive-state sufficiency resolves temporal aliasing at the information-structure level while making identifiability and the possibility of a zero-dimensional memory state explicit.
acceptance_conditions: The state is reproducibly estimable at online latency and predicts held-out future wrench or area beyond instantaneous variables across dwell, reversal, speed, and recovery shifts.
Each retained state dimension survives leave-one-state-out decision and outcome tests; a static uncertainty-aware representation remains an admissible winner.

required_mechanism_changes.failed_relation_state_or_information_str: Representation choice is currently justified by prediction fidelity even when feedback sensitivity, robust margins, authority, and latency prevent the residual mismatch from changing constrained impedance actions or outcomes.
required_mechanism_changes.required_mechanism_change: Gate representation complexity by closed-loop decision relevance: expose the boundary at which unabsorbed mismatch changes feasible action ranking, and default to the simplest equivalent representation on the absorbed side.
required_mechanism_changes.root_cause_resolution_rationale: This turns closed-loop absorption from a nuisance into an explicit null principle and regime boundary, preventing prediction-only gains from being misclassified as control value.
acceptance_conditions: Prespecified bandwidth, latency, disturbance-observability, authority, speed, and constraint-distance strata exhibit either action/outcome equivalence or repeatable non-equivalence in the predicted direction.
Prediction improvement alone cannot retain complexity, and equivalent simple control is recorded as a positive informative result.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Construct and test observable spatial statistics as conditional sufficient statistics for future wrench, constraint, and impedance-action consequences rather than as richer geometry for its own sake.
acceptance_conditions: Residual predictive value and action value are both evaluated on held-out geometry or specimen shifts.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Estimate remaining direction-dependent tangential and moment capacity early enough to alter impedance before a limit event.
acceptance_conditions: The state is calibrated against independent slip or capacity observations and is not merely a post-event alarm.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Compress loading history into a stable low-dimensional predictive state with explicit zero-state and over-parameterized alternatives.
acceptance_conditions: State order is selected by held-out predictive and decision sufficiency plus observability, not by in-sample fit.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Quantify when mismatch survives feedback and robust margins strongly enough to change feasible impedance ranking and outcomes.
acceptance_conditions: The boundary is tested across prespecified sensitivity, delay, authority, and constraint-distance strata.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Compare nested representations under equal data, compute, latency, objective, controller authority, safety margin, and tuning budgets, retaining only components with incremental decision and outcome value.
acceptance_conditions: Every retained component survives leave-one-component-out and matched equivalence tests.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Demonstrate calibration, reproducibility, estimator bandwidth, and latency for each nontrivial state used online.
acceptance_conditions: A state that is informative only offline cannot support an online principle claim and is reported separately.

required_capabilities.required_capability: Judge closed-loop value on prespecified safety and task endpoints that are not inputs to representation estimation.
acceptance_conditions: At least one independent task-quality endpoint and separate wrench, slip, contact, and implementation outcomes are reported with equivalence margins.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Operationalize finite-area state through independently calibrated statistics and demonstrate conditional anti-aliasing before testing control benefit.
acceptance_conditions: Matched scalar states with differing geometry must show a reproducible conditional consequence difference, or the spatial RMC is falsified in that regime.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Represent proximity to direction-dependent slip and moment capacity while randomizing or measuring friction and coupling-medium drift.
acceptance_conditions: Incremental value persists after conditioning on normal variables and measured friction proxies.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Test whether a finite predictive state Markovizes action-relevant dynamics over the control horizon without relying on nonidentifiable constitutive parameters.
acceptance_conditions: Conditional history dependence vanishes within declared uncertainty at the selected order and reappears under state removal, or the history state is rejected.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Map the sensitivity and constraint regime where representation error is absorbed versus decision-relevant, including estimator latency and fallback timing.
acceptance_conditions: Simple and rich representations cross the prespecified action and outcome equivalence boundaries in the predicted strata, or the boundary hypothesis is revised.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Separate prediction gain from action and outcome gain under matched resources and a common objective, safety envelope, and tuning protocol.
acceptance_conditions: An added component is retained only when action change exceeds implementation resolution and a held-out primary endpoint exceeds its justified equivalence margin with no material loss elsewhere.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Use nested additions, component removal, and state-order reduction to identify the smallest online-observable representation for each regime.
acceptance_conditions: Removing any retained component destroys the decision-value result; adding any rejected component fails to exceed equivalence margins.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Prespecify independent scanning quality, wrench safety, slip/contact stability, and implementation endpoints with sensor-grounded equivalence margins.
acceptance_conditions: No endpoint used to establish benefit is also used to estimate the representation, and unsuccessful trials are included.

design_obligations.design_obligation: Reduce competing principles to an atomic execution set whose tests each have explicit targets, terminal outcomes, and the smallest cost consistent with discriminating power.
acceptance_conditions: Every fatal assumption and discriminating prediction is hit by at least one informative test, with redundant tests removed before human approval.

same_field_mechanisms: Finite-area/contact-wrench, viscoelastic-state and uncertainty-aware impedance mechanisms were compared; simple feedback absorption remained live.

cross_domain_structural_isomorphisms.source_root_cause: Observation aliases histories with different futures
cross_domain_structural_isomorphisms.changed_relation_state_or_information_st: Raw history becomes finite predictive state
cross_domain_structural_isomorphisms.solution_principle: Retain the smallest observable state sufficient for controlled futures
cross_domain_structural_isomorphisms.causal_direction: compression restores sufficiency, then action ranking
activation_transfer_conditions: scalar-matched histories diverge and finite state is online-estimable
disanalogies: vision simulation is not deformable safety-critical contact
transfer_boundaries: unsafe excitation, unstable rank or decision equivalence

principle_search_record.closure_rationale: All four RMCs were searched across all four required dimensions to 79/80 queries. Four algorithm-independent competitors, including the simple null, survived to shared killer tests; inaccessible motion-cone abstract content was excluded.

candidate_principles.principle: Use the coarsest observable equivalence classes preserving conditional action ranking and outcomes.
activation_conditions: scalar-matched spatial states have different consequences
candidate_principles.intervention: Partition observations by conditional decision equivalence.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Scalar alias becomes a consequence-preserving quotient.
failure_conditions: no residual alias, online unobservability or outcome equivalence

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A stable low-dimensional observable quotient exists across held-out shifts.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: Minimal spatial state and scalar-sufficient boundary.

predictions.predicted_observation: The quotient removes scalar-matched residual differences; removing it changes action/outcome beyond margins.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Falsifiable spatial competitor; no full-field commitment.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Separates spatially aliased contact configurations by conditional action/outcome equivalence; unlike the wrench-margin Candidate it is not tied to proximity to wrench limits, unlike the predictive-state Candidate it does not require memory, and unlike feedback-gated simplicity it defines the retained state rather than when complexity is worth using.

candidate_principles.principle: Use the smallest observable coordinate of remaining direction-dependent wrench feasibility.
activation_conditions: normal state omits varying tangential/moment capacity
candidate_principles.intervention: Map observations to calibrated feasible-set slack.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Raw contact variables become a capacity-relative order coordinate.

fatal_assumptions.assumption: True feasibility slack mediates added information's action value.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: Minimal pre-limit coordinate and normal-only boundary.

predictions.predicted_observation: Divergence concentrates near small slack; conditioned on slack, raw detail adds no value.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Stricter physics-relative competitor; killable by failed mediation.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Orders states by remaining direction-dependent wrench slack; unlike the decision-sufficient quotient it commits to a capacity-relative causal coordinate, unlike predictive contact state it is instantaneous rather than historical, and unlike feedback-gated simplicity it targets pre-limit feasibility rather than the global complexity gate.

candidate_principles.principle: Use the lowest-order observable controlled-future predictions that render history conditionally irrelevant.
candidate_principles.intervention: Compress safe action-observation history into finite future predictions.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Raw history becomes finite observable predictive state.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: Restores temporal sufficiency without constitutive identification.
failure_conditions: unstable/unobservable order, zero-memory equivalence or no decision value

fatal_assumptions.assumption: Finite stable predictive state exists at safe excitation and online latency.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Reject/narrow; do not substitute detailed latent state.

predictions.predicted_observation: History dependence vanishes only after finite-state conditioning and returns on removal.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Predicts irreducible finite memory; exposed to zero-order killer.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Represents irreducible history through controlled-future predictions; unlike the spatial quotient or wrench margin it requires finite temporal state, and unlike feedback-gated simplicity it specifies how to encode memory rather than when any enriched state has closed-loop value.

candidate_principles.principle: Default to the simplest state; enrich only where unabsorbed mismatch changes actions and independent outcomes.
candidate_principles.origin: closed-loop sensitivity and value of information
activation_conditions: bandwidth, delay, authority and constraint distance are stratifiable
candidate_principles.intervention: Gate complexity on prospective closed-loop decision value.
candidate_principles.changed_structure: Rich state becomes a regime-conditioned option with simple fallback.
candidate_principles.root_cause_resolution_rationale: Makes feedback absorption a positive null result.
failure_conditions: no reproducible crossover or broadly useful rich state unrelated to sensitivity

fatal_assumptions.assumption: A measurable boundary separates absorbed from decision-relevant mismatch.
fatal_assumptions.failure_consequence: Reject gating; report a global winner or heterogeneity.

candidate_principles.provisional_scientific_delta: Closed-loop relevance map allowing a richer-is-unnecessary conclusion.

predictions.predicted_observation: Rich states are equivalent at high authority/large margin, but non-equivalent near sensitivity/constraint boundaries.

candidate_principles.status_rationale: Required simple/null competitor; prediction gain cannot defeat it.
candidate_principles.substantive_difference: Acts as the simple/null meta-principle that permits any richer Candidate only where mismatch survives feedback and changes independent outcomes; unlike the other three it can conclude that no enriched representation is needed in an absorbed regime.
